summary: Tested the rebuilt Organisation Structure page (/organisation). Two-panel DnD layout works correctly. Found and fixed a critical backend bug: assign-team endpoint used db.settings instead of db.org_settings, causing all drag-and-drop assignments to fail with 403. All 8 backend tests pass after fix.

critical.issue: Used `db.settings` collection to verify org membership, but settings are stored in `db.org_settings`. This caused ALL drag-and-drop team assignments to fail with 403 'Team not in your organisation'.
critical.status: FIXED - changed db.settings to db.org_settings in /app/backend/routers/org.py line ~285

integration_issues.issue: Manager trying to edit admin user (admin@supervision.com) gets 'Admin only' restriction shown in modal - this appears to be correct permission behavior (manager cannot edit admin users), but the error message 'Admin only' could be more descriptive.

issues: Route is at /organisation (not /org-structure as stated in the problem statement). Navigating to /org-structure redirects to /dashboard. Minor discrepancy from spec but functional.

action_items: The backend fix for db.settings → db.org_settings in assign-team has been applied and tested. Drag-and-drop should now work end-to-end.
Consider renaming /organisation route to /org-structure to match the spec, or update spec documentation.
Consider adding a clearer permission error message when manager tries to edit an admin user (currently shows red 'Admin only' text without context).
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: /app/backend/routers/org.py ~line 285 - assign-team endpoint used `db.settings` but settings are in `db.org_settings` collection. This caused all DnD assignments to fail silently (optimistic update revert after API call). Fixed by changing to `db.org_settings`.
The route mismatch: App.js registers the page at /organisation but the problem statement refers to /org-structure. Not functionally broken but misaligned with spec.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all UI flows working; minor edit-user restriction on admin user expected)

seed_data_creation: Created test team 'Test Team UI' and 2 TEST_InviteUser Org users during testing

The critical backend bug in assign-team has been fixed. manager@supervision.com org has: 1 setting (Sunflower House), 2 teams (Team A + Test Team UI created during test), 1 assigned user (Staff Member), 5+ unassigned users. Drag-and-drop should work end-to-end after the fix.

rca_of_issue.bug: PATCH /api/org/users/{id}/assign-team always returned 403 'Team not in your organisation'
rca_of_issue.root_cause: Line 285 of /app/backend/routers/org.py: `setting = await db.settings.find_one(...)` but org settings are stored in `db.org_settings` collection (confirmed by checking the GET /api/org/structure endpoint which uses `db.org_settings`). The wrong collection name caused the setting to not be found, triggering the 403 check.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Login as manager@supervision.com, 2. PATCH /api/org/users/{any_user_id}/assign-team with valid team_id, 3. Receive 403 'Team not in your organisation' despite team being in correct org
